name: BigCommerce Store API Account
description: BigCommerce Store API Account is a single-store OAuth credential set with an immutable static access token, client identity, API path and fixed resource scopes.
agentUseSummary: This store-owned credential pattern is visible as a canonical BigCommerce extension preview. Relay will not collect a static token or client secret or create a second commerce runtime beside the canonical provider.

capabilities.label: Use a store-managed API account
capabilities.description: If customer-managed static auth is approved, extend the canonical BigCommerce connector with an immutable store hash, account, token, scope and deletion binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate BigCommerce provider state
blocked.description: A store API account listing must not create a parallel token, tool or approval surface beside the canonical BigCommerce connector.

blocked.label: Capture BigCommerce API credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a merchant to paste a static access token or client secret into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Create or delete a store API account
blocked.description: Creating or deleting immutable store credentials is merchant administration and can remove account-owned webhooks or metafields.

blocked.label: Grant broad store scopes
blocked.description: Relay will not request payments, customers, orders, carts, checkout, scripts, content or other unrelated store authority.

blocked.label: Run BigCommerce actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; approved store credentials must reuse the canonical connector's exact store binding, typed tools, approvals and audits.

approvalProfiles.label: BigCommerce store API security review
approvalProfiles.description: This setup alias is not connectable. Static store credentials remain unavailable until a canonical BigCommerce connector has a least-privilege, revocable customer-managed identity design.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; store-owned credentials must extend the canonical BigCommerce provider pack.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; store-owned credentials must extend the canonical BigCommerce provider pack.

providerSetup.blocker: BigCommerce store API accounts use non-expiring static access tokens with immutable scopes. Tokens cannot be manually invalidated; revocation requires irreversible account deletion and can remove account-owned webhooks or metafields. Relay does not accept customer store credentials or expose an unbounded BigCommerce runtime.
providerSetup.nextAction: Prefer an installable app-level OAuth connection on the canonical BigCommerce provider. For an approved store-account case, extend that connector with immutable store hash/API path/account binding, minimum read-only scopes, encrypted token and client-secret storage, ownership evidence, explicit delete-and-recreate rotation, webhook/metafield cleanup and typed action policies.

evidence.supports: BigCommerce documents store, app and account API identities; store accounts have static access tokens, immutable scopes and single-store API paths.
BigCommerce warns never to transmit client secrets or access tokens in plaintext and explains a client secret can sign and decrypt provider JWTs.
BigCommerce states store credentials can be revoked only by irreversible API-account deletion and that account-owned webhooks do not persist after deletion.
BigCommerce instructs developers to grant minimum scopes and provides read-only variants for store resources alongside broad commerce and payment permissions.
